profile.summary: Side by Side is a nonprofit organization in the San Francisco Bay Area that serves young people ages 5 to 26 and their families. Its services include behavioral and mental health care, early intervention in schools, LGBTQIA+ support, transitional housing for foster youth, and special education. It operates the Irene M. Hunt School, a nonpublic day school for students in grades K through 12.
